falsifier: Any source form, cflag, or archive compiler that compiles a function whose only exception scaffolding is one inlined `throw()` helper to an `addi rN,r31,K / bl __unexpected` island with K raised by 8 while the `stwu r1,-F(r1)` frame size F is UNCHANGED. Run `python tools/gdl/composed_census/eh_island_layout_probe.py all` from the repository root: it prints the reachable (frame, island, insns) lattice and flags any cell equal to (72, 28, 38). A single such cell disproves this law. The law is also disproved by any counterexample where k != 12, i.e. an island offset that is not exactly 12 bytes above the start of the function's EH block.
subject: compiler:mwcc-gc-1.2.5
value: GEOMETRY OF THE MWCC __unexpected ISLAND ARGUMENT, measured 2026-09-01 with the project's GC/1.2.5 mwcceppc at game/movie/movieplayer's real cflags, over ~1370 compiles of a standalone lookalike of fn_800D9C5C whose baseline reproduces the shipped TU object EXACTLY (38 insns, frame 72, island r31+20), so these are the compiler's answers and not a model's. THE LAW: island_offset = eh_block_start + 12, where k = 12 is CONSTANT; eh_block_start = 8 + below_block; and below_block = 0 when the function has no touched-but-dead addressable local, else max(4, max alignof(L)) over those locals. The EH block itself is a fixed 36 bytes and its size does NOT vary with the number of cleanup actions. FOUR CONSEQUENCES, each measured. (1) A PURE PAD CANNOT MOVE THE ISLAND. An untouched `u8 unused[N]` is homed ABOVE the EH block and contributes below_block = 0; growing, shrinking, removing or rescoping it moves the frame and never the island. This independently reconfirms attempt.MP_fn800d9c5c-pad-sits-above-the-eh-record-...v1 and explains WHY that axis died. (2) WHAT MOVES THE ISLAND IS A TOUCHED-BUT-DEAD ADDRESSABLE LOCAL: a local written by a store that the optimiser then strips (so the instruction count is UNCHANGED) still forces frame allocation and creates the below_block. `u8 a[8]; a[0]=(u8)n;` moves the island +4 at 38 insns. This is the mechanism nobody had named. (3) THE SHIFT IS DRIVEN BY ALIGNMENT, NOT SIZE: every 4-aligned dead local, from `u8[1]` to `u32[3]` to an 8-byte struct, yields below_block = 4 and island +4 and SATURATES there; only an 8-ALIGNED dead local (`f64[1]`, `s64[1]`, a struct containing a double) yields below_block = 8 and island +8. Two independent 4-aligned dead locals accumulate to below_block = 8 as well. (4) THE DECISIVE COROLLARY -- island +8 AT CONSTANT FRAME IS UNOBTAINABLE FROM SOURCE. An 8-aligned dead local always costs +16 frame bytes (its 8-byte below_block plus 8 bytes of alignment/home), never +8, and two 4-aligned dead locals cost +16 or more. The reachable (frame, island) lattice at 38 insns contains (64,20), (72,20), (72,24), (80,20), (80,24), (80,28), (88,20), (88,24), (88,28), (88,32), (88,36), (96,28), (96,32), (96,36) -- island 28 NEVER co-occurs with frame 72. NEGATIVE DIMENSIONS, all measured this run and all flat at island 20 / frame 72: eleven EH-region SOURCE FORMS (inlined `throw()` helper, real global `operator delete` with throw() reached by a delete-expression, class-scope `operator delete`, `operator delete[]`, a non-empty `throw(T)` list, and an inline throw() helper calling another inline throw() helper); fifteen EH CLEANUP-ACTION shapes (destructible temporaries with empty destructors, several of them, inner scopes, sized destructible objects, base/derived destructor pairs, ctor+dtor pairs) -- confirming k does not grow with action count; seventeen ONE-FLAG CFLAG DELTAS including `-RTTI on`, `-align mac68k`, `-O3`, `-O4,p`, `-inline all`, `-inline auto,level=1`, `-fp fmadd`, `-enum min`, `-sym on`, `-opt schedule` and `-proc 750`; and ALL TWENTY compilers in build/compilers/GC. Of the whole archive only GC/1.1, GC/1.2.5 and GC/1.2.5n reproduce the target's 38-insn frame-72 shape at all, and all three place the island at r31+20; GC/1.1p1 gives r31+12 at frame 64, and the entire 1.3/2.x/3.x line gives r31+8 at frame 48 with a different instruction count. PRACTICAL USE: when a C++ function's only residual is the island immediate and the frames already agree, the residual is NOT source-reachable and no further local-declaration, EH-form, or flag probing is warranted -- screen with this law and park. Note that an island-immediate residual is ALSO barred from the postprocessor path by the Mandatory result policy, which forbids using postprocessing to hide an operand difference, so such a function is genuinely blocked rather than merely deferred.
